description_full: WebBeds Group Limited provides online travel booking services in Australia, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom, Spain, and internationally. It offers WebBeds, an online marketplace for the travel trade that sources hotel inventory from hotel and travel suppliers, connects, and aggregates that content in their platform and distributes it to a network of travel buyers who sell to the travelling public. The company was formerly known as Web Travel Group Limited and changed its name to WebBeds Group Limited in August 2026. WebBeds Group Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Melbourne, Australia.

financial_summary: WEBBEDS GROUP LTD is a small-cap consumer cyclical business with a $844M market cap on $267M of annual revenue.

The top line has compounded at +1% over the past three years, which puts it in mature, slow-growth territory. Operating margins are expanding by +2.6pp year-over-year, which is one of the strongest signals that the moat is deepening.

Returns on capital run at 18% against a 8% cost of capital, a 9-point spread that creates value, though narrow enough that competitive pressure could close it. Gross margins of 100% confirm genuine pricing power.
The business throws off $64M in free cash flow — roughly 24 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage runs at 3.0×.
Shareholder yield is only 0.0%, a thin return of capital, and within its sector the business captures 3.1× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.
